  • If a nickname contains personal data (e.g., your real name), it will be treated as personal data under GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation).
  • Nicknames are not permanently stored on our servers. They are only used during active game sessions and are deleted automatically after the session ends or when the app is uninstalled.
  • Opponent Nicknames: If you play against an opponent, their nickname is only stored locally on your device and is not shared with third parties.
